summary: Frontend-only E2E testing for 'Ganapati Modak Dash' complete. Loading -> Main Menu -> panels (howto/scores/settings) -> Play -> HUD -> passive Game Over -> Play Again / Main Menu -> localStorage persistence across reload all work. Score increments over time. Keyboard controls fire without errors. Quality/music/SFX toggles work. Game Over correctly triggered after ~124s of passive play; all required stat fields (Distance, Modaks Collected, Highest Combo, Final Score, Personal Best) are shown. localStorage key 'ganapati_modak_dash_v1' is written and retained across reload; Best on menu updates to 641.
critical_code_review_comments: Passive game-over takes ~120s because obstacles rarely spawn in the exact center lane and each hit grants 1.6s invulnerability. Not a bug, but consider slightly higher center-lane obstacle density for faster fail-state during idle to improve tutorial/onboarding feedback.
GanapatiDash.jsx is ~550 lines and mixes engine wiring, HUD, panels, and input listeners. Consider splitting HUD/Panels/InputHooks into separate components for maintainability.

Storage.getSettings default is returned even on parse success without merging with defaults; if a new setting key is added later, saved settings will be missing that key. Merge with a DEFAULT_SETTINGS object like Storage.get() does.

Touch move handler calls e.preventDefault() only during 'playing'; that's fine, but 'touchmove' listener is attached with { passive: false } always — micro-optimization: only attach non-passive during playing screen.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage 'ganapati_modak_dash_v1' before run to verify best-score persistence from scratch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passive game-over requires ~120-150s of waiting (do not budget less). Score/Distance/Lives all sampled via data-testid. LocalStorage key is 'ganapati_modak_dash_v1'. Some GPU 'ReadPixels' console warnings and '__emergent_overlay__/report' 404s are platform noise, not app bugs.
